ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Meeting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
